settings.heading: Jewels made to outlast the moment.
settings.subheading: Three generations of artisans. One obsession with light.

settings.title: Our Story
settings.text: Pavé was founded in a single workshop in Antwerp in 1962, where the art of setting tiny stones flush into precious metal was elevated into a house style. Today we work with master artisans across three continents — each piece still finished by hand, still held to the same impossible standard our founder called "the light test."
